## Notes

Falling-sand game first released 2008 by Stanislaw Skowronek; maintained by GitHub contributors under GPLv3; Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, Steam (2024); 258 elements as of February 2025; online save sharing with votes; Lua scripting.
